name: boxdawn-guard
description: Judges each Bash and PowerShell command, and each read of a secret file by name, before Claude runs it: deny, ask, or no decision.

api_key.title: Boxdawn API key (optional)
api_key.description: With a key, the guard fetches signed rule updates from Boxdawn at session start (the request carries the key only). Leave empty to use the fixed rules with no network connection.

keep_blocks_local.title: Keep the block record on this machine
keep_blocks_local.description: On a paid plan the guard sends its block record (tool, deny or ask, rule ids, where the target sits; never a command or a path) to Boxdawn at session start. Turn this on to keep it on this machine only.

keep_secrets_out_of_grep.title: Keep secret files out of grep -r
keep_secrets_out_of_grep.description: Adds --exclude flags to a recursive grep in Bash so it leaves secret files out. Turn this off and no flags are added; a search that starts in a credentials folder still asks.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the guard's messages.
